yaw_convention: yaw_deg=0 means gate +Z (flight direction) is world +X; positive yaw rotates the gate counter-clockwise about world +Z (right-hand rule); at yaw=0, gate +X = world -Y and gate +Y = world -Z.
gate_note: 7-gate stadium for a top-speed attempt (2026-11-18): 28 m and 22 m straights, 6 m-radius turns, 1.5 m gates, all at 2.5 m; about 46 m x 18 m of floor. Seven gates like UZH's Swift track (25 x 25 m hangar), stretched into straights so the Starling can reach 12+ m/s.
